purpose: Teach: 高まり/渡さ/覆わ/広まっ/害する/根ざし/崩す/利か

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 需要の高まりに注目しろ
lines.en: Pay attention to the rising demand.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding clip on each word. No warmth. Eyes forward. The tone of someone used to being listened to without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。機密を渡さない方針を徹底しております
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining a strict policy against disclosure of confidential information.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Formal without being stiff. The cadence of someone used to reporting upward — careful, complete, unadorned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の弱点が覆われないよう対策しろ
lines.en: Make sure our vulnerabilities don't become exposed.
lines.style: Clipped imperative. Weight on 「対策しろ」. No elaboration needed — he expects understanding and execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ブランドが広まった成果を報告いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll report on the results of our brand expansion.
lines.style: Respectful, steady tone. Neither apologetic nor boastful. The rhythm of someone delivering concrete progress to someone who judges by outcomes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の評判を害する行為は厳禁だ
lines.en: Any action that damages our reputation is strictly forbidden.
lines.style: Low, final-sounding. Weight on 「厳禁」 like a boundary line drawn. Not angry — colder than that. Absolute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地元に根ざした商品を展開中です
lines.en: Yes. We're currently deploying products with strong local roots.
lines.style: Affirming, grounded. Slight emphasis on 「展開中」 to show active progress. Calm, responsive without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: シェアを崩す戦略を立てろ
lines.en: Develop a strategy to take market share.
lines.style: Direct order. Slight pause before 「戦略を立てろ」. The voice of someone who expects this will be done, not debated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い手法が利かない市場に進出します
lines.en: Yes. We'll expand into markets where traditional methods no longer work.
lines.style: Closing statement — confident but not rushed. Even pace. The note of someone confirming they understand the direction and are ready to move forward.
